title: Tunisian Jasmine Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by the spices of Tunisia, featuring jasmine rice and a blend of warm spices.

ingredients.name: tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the tunisian spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the jasmine rice and stir to combine with the spice blend.
Add the warm water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and season with flaky sea salt to taste.
Serve the tunisian jasmine rice hot, garnished with additional tunisian spice blend if desired.
